CORRECTION: NOT a matched whole-frame comparison. The real (f31) and rust (f140) frames are on DIFFERENT animation phases, with different field layout/background/navi scale. This does not show parity -- the scenes do not match.

BLOCKER PROOF: zeroing EVERY OAM entry leaves the frame identical — the game reloads its whole render config (OAM/DISPCNT/palette) each frame, so no write-based strip works. Only a ROM code patch to the field/HUD draw can achieve whole-frame parity.
BREAKTHROUGH: --disable-bg strips the field/background/panels — only MegaMan + attack (OBJ) show on black, matching the Rust sterile render for a whole-frame diff
